hq_intro_desc: What the Prophet ﷺ narrated from his Lord, Mighty and Majestic: the meaning is inspired by God and the wording is in the Prophet's own words ﷺ, full of mercy, hope and forgiveness.
hq_what_is_body: It is a hadith the Prophet ﷺ attributes to God, saying: "God Almighty said". The meaning is from God and the wording is from the Messenger of God ﷺ, and it is called "qudsi" out of purity, transcendence and reverence.
hq_diff_title: How it differs from the Quran and the Prophetic hadith:
hq_diff_body: The Noble Quran is miraculous in wording and meaning and is recited as worship in prayer. A Hadith Qudsi is not valid for prayer. A Prophetic hadith has a meaning that is revelation or reasoned judgment, in the Prophet's wording ﷺ, without being attributed to God's speech.

hc_subtitle: Occasions, acts of worship and spiritual times
hc_calib_title: Does moon sighting differ in your country?
hc_calib_desc: You can adjust the calendar manually by adding or subtracting days to match exactly.
hc_fast_recommended: Fasting is recommended on this blessed day!
hc_white_days_note: This is one of the three White Days (13, 14, 15) of the lunar month.
hc_mon_thu_note: Fasting on Mondays and Thursdays is a confirmed Sunnah of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, as deeds are presented to Allah on these days.
hc_no_events: There are no general annual occasions on this day. It is a good opportunity for regular adhkar and drawing closer to Allah through good deeds.
hc_upcoming_desc: Look forward to the seasons of goodness and prepare spiritually to earn great reward and forgiveness.
hc_ev_hijri_new_year_description: The start of the new Hijri year and the anniversary of the Prophet's ﷺ migration from Makkah to Madinah.
hc_ev_hijri_new_year_recommendation: Reflect on the lessons of the blessed Hijrah and renew your intention for the new year.
hc_ev_ashura_eve_description: The ninth day of sacred Muharram. Fasting it together with Ashura is recommended, to differ from the Jews.
hc_ev_ashura_eve_recommendation: Fasting Tasu'a and Ashura expiates the sins of the previous year.
hc_ev_ashura_description: The day Allah saved Musa (peace be upon him) and his people from Pharaoh and his army. Fasting it expiates the sins of the past year.
hc_ev_ashura_recommendation: It is Sunnah to fast this day in gratitude to Allah and following the Messenger ﷺ.
hc_ev_prophets_birthday_description: The anniversary of the birth of the Seal of the Prophets and Messengers, our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
hc_ev_prophets_birthday_recommendation: Send abundant blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ, study his fragrant biography and adopt his noble character.
hc_ev_isra_miraj_description: The miraculous journey of the Prophet ﷺ from the Sacred Mosque to Al-Aqsa Mosque, then his ascent to the highest heavens, when the prayer was made obligatory.
hc_ev_isra_miraj_recommendation: Honor the obligatory prayer and keep it on time with humility and presence of heart.
hc_ev_shaban_mid_description: A blessed night on which the Qibla was changed from Bayt al-Maqdis to the Holy Kaaba in Makkah.
hc_ev_shaban_mid_recommendation: Seek forgiveness, make dua and cleanse hearts of grudges and hatred in preparation for Ramadan.
hc_ev_ramadan_start_description: The beginning of the month of fasting, night prayer and the Quran, the best month of the year, when the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of Hell are closed.
hc_ev_ramadan_start_recommendation: Fast the days, pray at night, recite plenty of Quran, and avoid idle talk and sins.
hc_ev_badr_battle_description: The first decisive battle in Islam, in which truth triumphed over falsehood by Allah's grace and the descent of angels to support the believers.
hc_ev_badr_battle_recommendation: Remember the patience, steadfastness and striving of the Companions to spread guidance and faith.
hc_ev_laylat_al_qadr_name: Last Ten Nights of Ramadan and Seeking Laylat al-Qadr
hc_ev_laylat_al_qadr_description: The greatest nights of the year, including Laylat al-Qadr, which is better than a thousand months and in which the Quran was revealed.
hc_ev_laylat_al_qadr_recommendation: Strive in worship, revive the night with prayer, dua and dhikr, and recite: "اللهم إنك عفو تحب العفو فاعف عني".
hc_ev_eid_fitr_eve_name: Eve of Eid al-Fitr and Eid Takbeer
hc_ev_eid_fitr_eve_description: The last night of Ramadan, when it is recommended to pay Zakat al-Fitr, glorify Allah and prepare for the blessed Eid al-Fitr.
hc_ev_eid_fitr_eve_recommendation: Pay Zakat al-Fitr before the Eid prayer and revive the night with takbeer and thanks to Allah for completing the fast.
hc_ev_eid_fitr_description: The day of reward and joy for Muslims after completing the blessed month of Ramadan. Fasting on this day is forbidden.
hc_ev_eid_fitr_recommendation: Say takbeer and tahlil, perform ghusl, wear perfume and new clothes, attend the Eid prayer, keep family ties and smile at people.
hc_ev_shawwal_six_description: Fasting six days of Shawwal is recommended: whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwal is as if they fasted all year.
hc_ev_shawwal_six_recommendation: Hurry to fast the six days for multiplied reward; they may be fasted separately or consecutively throughout the month.
hc_ev_hajj_ten_description: The best days of the world. Good deeds in them are more beloved to Allah than striving in His cause; the reward is multiplied.
hc_ev_hajj_ten_recommendation: Increase tahlil, takbeer and tahmid, fast if able, and give charity and do good deeds.
hc_ev_arafah_description: The greatest day of Hajj and its main pillar. For non-pilgrims, fasting it expiates the sins of the past and coming year; it is a day of answered duas and freedom from Hellfire.
hc_ev_arafah_recommendation: Fast this great day and make abundant dua, saying: "لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير".
hc_ev_eid_adha_description: The Day of Sacrifice and the greatest day with Allah, commemorating Ibrahim's (peace be upon him) obedience to his Lord and the sacrifice offered in place of Isma'il (peace be upon him).
hc_ev_eid_adha_recommendation: Attend the Eid prayer, say takbeer often, offer the sacrifice and distribute it to the poor and needy, and keep family ties.
hc_ev_tashreeq_days_description: The three days after Eid al-Adha (11, 12, 13 Dhul-Hijjah), days of eating, drinking and remembering Allah; fasting them is not permitted.
hc_ev_tashreeq_days_recommendation: Say the specified takbeer after each obligatory prayer and be generous to family and children with kindness.
is_fri_msg: Friday is the weekly Eid and has the hour of answered prayer. Increase your istighfar, ask for forgiveness and send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ.
is_suhoor_msg: You are now in the last third of the night, the time of the Divine descent: «And in the hours before dawn they would seek forgiveness». A great chance for Sayyid al-Istighfar and the two rak'ahs of repentance.
is_morning_msg: Your day has begun, and the best way to open your record is with Sayyid al-Istighfar and sincere repentance, so you remain in Allah's protection.
is_evening_msg: In the evening, fortify your soul with great istighfar and close the day by asking for forgiveness and Allah's pleasure.
is_subtitle: Prophetic istighfar supplications and the repentance prayer, step by step
is_index_title: Index of selected istighfar & repentance supplications
is_tp_title: The Repentance Prayer and its Sunnah
is_tp_subtitle: Two rak'ahs that wash away sins and renew the covenant with the Forgiving, the Merciful
is_tp_proof: Its legitimacy from the noble Sunnah:
is_cond_title: Pillars and conditions of sincere repentance
is_cond1_desc: Leave the disobedience and its causes at once, seeking Allah's face.
is_cond2_desc: Feel Allah's greatness and regret falling short and disobeying His command.
is_cond3_desc: Make a firm, sincere intention never to go back to the sin.
is_cond4_desc: If the sin involves people's rights (money, honor, wrongdoing), you must make it right with them.
is_steps_title: How to pray the repentance prayer (step by step)
is_steps_hint: Tap each step to confirm you completed it with humility
is_step1_title: Step 1: Purification and a complete ablution
is_step1_desc: Perform a good, complete ablution intending to be purified of sins and mistakes, recalling sins falling away with the drops of water.
is_step2_title: Step 2: Pray two humble rak'ahs alone
is_step2_desc: Face the Qibla and intend the two rak'ahs of repentance (a recommended voluntary prayer). Pray them in solitude and calm, without letting your mind wander to worldly matters.
is_step2_dua: Recite in them Al-Fatiha and what is easy of the Quran, with humility and reflection.
is_step3_title: Step 3: Prolong prostration and supplicate with remorse
is_step3_desc: A servant is closest to his Lord when prostrating. Admit your weakness and sin, and weep or try to weep before Allah, apologetic and remorseful.
is_step4_title: Step 4: Salutation and sitting for istighfar
is_step4_desc: After the salutation, stay at your prayer spot, sit facing the Qibla and supplicate with Sayyid al-Istighfar and the transmitted repentance supplications.
is_step5_title: Step 5: Give charity and increase good deeds
is_step5_desc: After the repentance prayer, it is recommended to follow it with even a small charity and a good deed that erases the effect of the sin («good deeds wipe out evil deeds»).
is_log_msg: May Allah accept your repentance and good deeds, forgive your sins and grant you steadfastness and tranquility!
is_qa_title: Important questions and rulings on the repentance prayer
is_q1: Q: Does the repentance prayer have a fixed time?
is_a1: A: It is legislated at any time, day or night, as soon as a sin occurs; the best time is the last third of the night (before dawn).
is_q2: Q: Is the repentance prayer repeated if the sin recurs?
is_a2: A: Yes. Whenever a servant sins, it is prescribed that he repent and pray two rak'ahs; Allah is Forgiving and Merciful and does not tire of forgiving until the servant tires of seeking forgiveness.
is_call_heading: The Generous call of Allah to those who repent
is_virtue1_title: Allah's love for those who repent
is_virtue2_title: Allah's great joy at His servant's repentance
is_virtue3_title: Evil deeds turned into good deeds
is_virtue5_title: Relief from worries and a way out of hardship
is_virtue6_title: Safety from punishment and peace of heart
is_tips_title: Practical tips for the one who repents and seeks forgiveness
is_tip1: Commit yourself to at least 100 istighfars a day, on your way or in spare moments.
is_tip2: Make Sayyid al-Istighfar your morning and evening wird that you never abandon.
is_tip3: If you slip into a sin, hurry to pray the two rak'ahs of repentance without delay, for Satan hopes you postpone your repentance.
is_tip4: Always remember that Allah's mercy is wider than all your sins, and repentance wipes out what came before it entirely.
